SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(anglers) + COUNT(DISTINCT boat), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season
ORDER BY fish_date_season DESC, fish_date_doy
LIMIT 100

  fish_date_doy,

  ROUND(SUM(yt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(anglers) + COUNT(DISTINCT boat), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 280 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season
